answer: Require one carrier-verified phone number per identity, locked for twelve months, with no reuse for a second account. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must buy and keep 1,000 separate SIM subscriptions, about $5,000 a month plus activation fees, and carriers flag bulk purchases. One flagged number revokes that identity and burns its pending rewards. That cost stretches across a full horizon of twelve months, and it leaves no reef of cheap spare identities to draw on, since every sparrow in the flock still needs its own paid line.
